result.input_evidence: guest-asserted acks; state_changed is the host's own pixel+tree comparison in strict mode; in fast mode it is the guest's tree-change verdict and a fast frame may be mid-animation

settle.meaning: mode=fast frames may be mid-animation; ack_ms is publish -> the gesture's own FINISHED, first_change_ms is publish -> the probe sample that differs from the pre-action tree, frame_ms is publish -> the bound C1 store

input.how: guest_command_ms is the whole tap/key/type_text round trip (guest delivery + its settle window + C1 capture); input_ack_ms is the guest's own delivery ack; absorb_ms is host PNG read + tree parse; settle_estimate_ms is the remainder

timing.note: total_ms is the whole serve verb; the other fields are measured around the acos-art round trip and the host-side absorb
